Write a short, professional, helpful customer support reply.

Write a short, professional customer support reply.

Rules:
- Do not mention AI.
- Use only information explicitly available in the ticket data provided above.
- Do not invent product features, menu names, steps, policies, timelines, or instructions.
- If the ticket asks for information that is not provided in the available data, do not guess.
- In that case, acknowledge the request and tell the customer that the support team will provide the correct instructions.
- Do not make financial promises.
- Do not promise compensation.
- Do not claim the issue is resolved unless the provided data confirms it.
- Keep the reply concise.
- Use a friendly professional tone.
- Return only the reply text.
